name: Norditek Group AB (publ)
summary: Norditek Group AB (publ), established in 1998 and headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, specializes in providing equipment for material recycling and conversion across Sweden. The company develops, sells, and offers rental or leasing options for crushers, sorting plants, and proprietary machines, all designed to transform various materials into marketable products. Their product range further extends to waste compactors, magnets, wind visibility and water bath products, used machinery, and a variety of accessories.
